title: The legacy criteria of RWB-E6-036 are generic, its test cases carry no data and the story master gives no requirement id
source: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Story, Acceptance criteria, Data, Test cases); FSD P8 Payments and posting v3 A2.8.4.1 (AC-P8-008-01); work package line for RWB-P8-E6036-APP (reqs empty)
description: The story owns two legacy criteria word for word and both are generic. AC1 reads Given the data and the rule version this feature needs are in place / When its trigger arrives / Then builds the provision inputs Finance needs from the case and asset positions / Then the system writes the result to the decision log with the rule version, and AC2 reads Given the decision log cannot be written / When the action is taken / Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003. The four legacy test cases repeat the same rows with no case, product group, amount, asset or business date. The FSD keeps the feature as FEAT-PAY-08 and its main success criterion AC-P8-008-01 is one line marked Written one epic ahead, so the module document adds no value either. The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice, which is why section 18 traces the two criteria to FEAT-PAY-08, AC-P8-008-01 and BR-054 of the Epic 6 BRD rather than to a requirement row, and why the story supplies its own synthetic data set for its tests.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-036 AC1 and AC2 as quoted; legacy test cases TC-E6-036-01 Produce provision inputs and TC-E6-036-02 Not recorded with no data column; FSD P8 v3 A2.8.4.1 AC-P8-008-01 The data and rules it needs are in place / The trigger arrives / The result is recorded with its rule version / Written one epic ahead; the T8 requirement traceability table of TSD P8 v2 is empty.
owner_role: P8 business analyst and the FSD owner
proposed: Keep the two criteria unchanged, test them on the synthetic set of the assumption, and add the requirement row for FEAT-PAY-08 to the PRD of P8 so that the traceability table of the FSD and the TSD can name it in their next versions.

title: The field list, the period, the rule rows and the run and activity names of the provision-input build are published nowhere
source: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Data, Endpoints); FSD P8 v3 A2.8.1, A2.8.2, A2.8.3.1 and A2.8.4.4; TSD P8 v2 T3.1, T3.2 and T-A.1 (no element for provision inputs); Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 BR-054, ASM-012 and Q-005; context pack P8 ownership rows
description: The legacy story, the FSD and the TSD name the feature and its objective but publish none of the values the build needs. No source gives the field list of a provision input, the period it covers, the frequency of the build, the package code or the rule IDs of the provision-input family, or the names of the run and the activity that build it; the FSD says only that the step receives its trigger - a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer - and applies the rules, and the TSD has no element, list or operation for provision inputs at all. The provision step, its thresholds and the re-appraisal interval are policy parameters held as data (ASM-012) and their values are still open in Q-005 of the same BRD. The story therefore reads every one of those values as a rule row or a policy parameter at its version in force, carries the run and activity names as placeholders, and names no invented field, threshold, period or rule.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-036 Data rows recovery_case, v_ace_payment, v_ace_npa_asset, decision_log_entry and rule_row with no provision-input entity; FSD P8 v3 A2.8.2 step 1 Receives its trigger: a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer and step 2 Applies the rules; TSD P8 v2 T-A.1 lists only API-P8-001 and API-P8-002, both for proceeds; Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 ASM-012 The provision step thresholds and the re-appraisal interval are policy parameters held as data and Q-005 What are the provision step thresholds and the re-appraisal interval for a held asset.
owner_role: P7 rule owner and the P8 solution architect
proposed: Publish the provision-input field list, its period and its frequency in the API Specification and the Service Contract Catalog, publish the package code and the rule IDs of the family with the answers to Q-005, and name the run and the activity in the Temporal Workflow and Activity Catalog.

title: The legacy story reads v_ace_payment and v_ace_npa_asset in process, while the target gives the ACE views to rwb-source-data alone and the asset position to rwb-asset
source: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Data); FSD P8 v3 A2.8.3.1 (VR-P8-008-1); context pack P8 (no ACE grant, ownership rows); Architecture v5 slide 4 (S5 rwb-asset) and slide 29 (the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-05
description: The legacy Data table lists v_ace_payment with DF-ACE-043 to DF-ACE-054 and v_ace_npa_asset with DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219 as sources of the provision input, in process, and VR-P8-008-1 reads v_ace_batch_status for the staleness check. In the target only rwb-source-data holds SELECT on the recovery.v_ace_* views, so DP-05 applies to this service as a prohibition; the case position is rwb-case's and the held-asset position, its holding age and its provision step are rwb-asset's, which owns the asset stock position per case. The story keeps the staleness rule and its message exactly and moves the three reads to the owners' contracts, and the difference is recorded here so that the legacy Data table, the FSD data table and the DP-05 row agree in their next versions.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-036 Data rows v_ace_payment DF-ACE-043 to DF-ACE-054 and v_ace_npa_asset DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219; FSD P8 v3 A2.8.3.1 VR-P8-008-1 reads v_ace_batch_status; the context pack lists only proceeds, the two proceeds operations, the three events and the two jobs among the P8 ownership rows and no ACE view; Architecture v5 slide 29 gives the views to rwb-source-data; Architecture v5 slide 4 places the asset stock position in S5 rwb-asset.
owner_role: P1 source-data owner, S5 asset owner and the P8 solution architect
proposed: Keep the receipt, batch-status and asset reads on the contracts of rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-asset with the freshness stamp, retire the v_ace_payment, v_ace_npa_asset and v_ace_batch_status reads of this service, and correct the Data table of the legacy key and of FSD P8 A2.8 in their next versions.

title: No table, file, interface or acknowledgement is published for the provision input or for the finance provision feed
source: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Endpoints, Screen and states); FSD P8 v3 A2.8.2 (integration points ALS and GL); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-WO-26 and R-WO-27 (finance provision feed, finance_feed_status); TSD P8 v2 T3.1 (proceeds is the only P8 table); P8 context pack ownership rows
description: The routing logic names a finance provision feed with a finance_feed_status that may be rejected and retried (R-WO-26 and R-WO-27), and the feature is called the provision inputs Finance needs, but no source publishes a P8 table that holds a provision input, an outbound interface number for the feed, a file layout, a transport, a recipient path or an acknowledgement. TSD P8 T3.1 publishes proceeds as the only table of the module and the context pack lists no other P8 table, and the interfaces of the service in TSD P8 T5.1 are ALS and GL only. The story therefore answers the input set as the result of the build step, adds no table and no column, declares no event for it, and holds the delivery and its acknowledgement out of scope until the interface is published.
evidence: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-WO-26 Send the provision inputs and the tax file to Finance with timer month-end close and R-WO-27 finance_feed_status = rejected; TSD P8 v2 T3.1 publishes proceeds only; TSD P8 v2 T5.1 lists INT-02, INT-03 and INT-16 only; the context pack lists one table (proceeds), two REST operations, three events and two jobs for P8 and no file interface.
owner_role: P8 solution architect and the finance-feed interface owner
proposed: Publish the finance provision feed as a numbered interface with its file layout, transport, recipient, retry policy and acknowledgement, and decide whether the built input is held in rwb_payment or handed straight to the feed; until then the input set stays the answer of the build step.
